BODY REAR SEAT
REMOVAL
1. REMOVE SEATBACK ASSEMBLY LH AND RH
(a) Release the seatback assembly LH and RH.
{b) Remove the 4 bolts.
Torque: 18 N-m {185 kgf •cm, 13 ft.Jbf}
{c) Remove the seatback assembly LH and RH.
2. REMOVE SEAT CUSHION ASSEMBLY
3. REMOVE SIDE HINGE LH AND AH
Torque: 7.8 N•m (80 kgf,cm, 69 ft-lbf)
4. REMOVE CENTER HINGE
Torque: 18 N-m (185 kgf.cm, 13 tt-lbf}
5. REMOVE SEATBACK LOCK STRIKER (See page B0---88)
Torque: 18 N,m (185 kgf.cm, 13 ft.lbf}
